findings.note: review 1: upload racing a folder delete left an active file in a trashed folder; folder row locks (FOR SHARE / subtree FOR UPDATE) and purge rescue of active rows, concurrency tests
review 1: concurrent same-name folder create/rename now 409 instead of 500 (also test-writer observation 1)
review 1: adopted user folder gets canonical special spelling, reindex and change event (also test-writer observation 2)
review 1: upload streaming holds a DB connection; documented in storeFile KDoc, the row lock is taken only after the blob write; streaming outside the transaction belongs to files-api if needed
review 2: purge racing a restore deleted the restored item; purge locks rows and re-checks deleted_at in SQL (8e66e73), 4 race tests
review 2: restore does not lock the parent; a stranded active item is moved to the root on purge, nothing is lost
review 2: rare unique-name races (first special-folder creation vs user 'Attachments', restore rename) give 500; DB keeps the invariant, a retry succeeds
review 2: overlapping subtree deletes can deadlock across lockSubtree rounds; PostgreSQL aborts one transaction, data stays consistent
